department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Staged financial assistance scheme for girl children from economically weaker families in Maharashtra, paid at milestones through schooling.
benefits: Cumulative staged cash benefit disbursed at birth, school milestones, and on turning 18 (subject to remaining unmarried till then).
eligibility: Girl child born in a yellow/orange ration card (economically weaker) family in Maharashtra
application_steps: Apply through the Anganwadi worker or Mahadbt portal
